text: Then she saw it was meant for a nest with a bird sitting on it. Underneath were the printed letters and they said: “I will cum bak.” “I AM COLIN” Mary took the picture back to the house when she went to her supper and she showed it to Martha. “Eh!” said Martha with great pride. “I never knew our Dickon was as clever as that. That there’s a picture of a missel thrush on her nest, as large as life an’ twice as natural.” Then Mary knew Dickon had meant the picture to be a message.
